title: pm-dispatch(triage): a round reads every main and queue red since the last record, answers pm:retriage on epics, and a lane holds a head with a Contract-review-hold: line that check-owed-reviews reads
body:
Fixes #27370
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:分诊每轮改读「上份轮次记录 fire 以来」全部 main push、schedule 与合并队列结论,窗内无锚的红当轮立 p0 锚卡(main 已转绿也照立并点名承修卡),断档逾 90 分钟在记录里写明;`pm:epic` 卡上的 `pm:retriage` 即答;车道可落一行 `Contract-review-hold:` 暂缓本 head 送审,`check-owed-reviews.mjs` 读它:活的 hold 只挡 (b)、新 head 即清、逾 24 小时列进分诊轮次记录。
- 为什么改:10-28 分诊停了约 10 小时,回来第一轮只读最新一跑,两次 main 红没有锚卡;一张 epic 上问分诊的三个问题等了约 10 小时;车道用散文说「这个 head 先别审」,分诊按 (b) 认领后又撤回。现在主干红在断档里漏不掉,epic 的提问当轮有答,「先别审」是一行脚本读得懂的字,不再靠人重读散文。
- 风险与回滚:只改两份技能文本(行数不变:60/60、102/102)与两个只报不拦的脚本;不新增门禁、check-run、workflow 步骤或半状态行。回滚 = revert 本 PR。hold 写错格式读作 unreadable、什么都不挡,响亮而非静默。
- 先看:① `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的 `owedReviewRow`((b) 让位于活 hold 的两行与 `listed`);② `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `readContractReviewHold` / `contractReviewHold`(四段解析、newest governs、24 小时只是读数);③ `references/contract-review.md` L29–31 与 `references/triage-duties.md` L26–27、L60。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`,预期尾行 `316 cases pass` 与 `62 cases pass in 9 batteries`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(`.claude/**` 为 Tier S:席位契约复核 PASS 后入队)。

## What changes

Three rules, one line each in the file that owns it, and one reader of an existing list. No new gate, check-run, workflow step or half-state row.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` — 102 → 102 lines

- **Item 1, L26–27 (new):** each round reads every `main` push, schedule and merge-queue conclusion since the previous round record's fire time, ⛔ not only the newest run; an unanchored red in that window gets a p0 anchor in the round — `main` green again still files it and names the card that carries the fix; a round with no record for over 90 minutes says so in its record.
- **Item 2, L60 (in place, beside 「父单永不派发」):** a `pm:epic` card's `pm:retriage` is answered at once; parents are still never dispatched.
- L9 (in place, bytes only): the review step names the hold line among what `check-owed-reviews.mjs` reads.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` — 60 → 60 lines

- **Item 3, L29–31 (new), beside the claim lines L26–28:**
  - L29: a lane deferring review of this head posts `Contract-review-hold: SESSION · head SHA · REASON · until CONDITION` (the template, verbatim in a code span; placeholders spelled in angle brackets in the file).
  - L30: a new head clears it; while it names the current head, gap rule (b) does not fire; once the condition is met the holding lane hangs `needs:contract-review` or posts a hand-off line.
  - L31: a hold over 24 hours with its condition unmet is listed in the triage round record (`check-owed-reviews.mjs` marks it).
- L60 (in place, bytes only): no check, workflow or queue guard reads the hold line either.

### `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` — the recogniser, beside its siblings

- `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HOLD_KEY` / `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HOLD_TEMPLATE` / `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HOLD_LIST_HOURS = 24`, built with the file's one `keyLineRegex` convention.
- `readContractReviewHold(text)`: four facts split on the doorbell's dot — the session (the claim reader's session regex, not a second spelling), `head` 7–40 hex, a non-empty reason, `until` plus a non-empty condition. A missing fact, a fifth part, a reason that is itself the `until` clause, or a session of another shape is started-and-unreadable; the template copied unedited is unreadable.
- `contractReviewHold(rows, headSha, { now })`: newest governs (`latestMarkedComment`, as the hand-off line), head matched by prefix either way. `live` / `stale` (head moved, cleared) / `absent` / `unreadable` (holds nothing). Age is timed from the comment's `created_at`; at 24 hours `overdue: true`, which is a reading — the hold stays `live`. No stamp gives `overdue: null` (unknown), never `false`.
- Additive: new exports only, no signature change; the hand-off and claim readers are untouched (pinned below). The `self-test-reads` declaration keeps its line 77, which the dispatch-gates census pins.

### `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` — the reader

- Each row carries `hold` (`state`, `id`, `session`, `reason`, `until`, `at`, `ageMinutes`, `overdue`, `holds`, `listed`, `gaps`).
- Trigger (b) yields to a live hold; (a) and (c) still fire — the holding lane ends its hold with (a), and a lane seat that is gone is (c).
- Status stays one of four. A held head is `WAIT` (the lane's own), and the row prints the hold and the (b) it holds.
- `listed` = a live hold that is overdue or cannot be timed, on a `WAIT` row. The row ends `⏳ HOLD 24 h old — list it in the triage round record`, and the report adds a block under the rows naming the PR, holder, post time, age and condition.

## Tests

| Self-test | before (`c5d46341`) | after (`167b0027`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` | 297 cases, floor 16 batteries | 316 cases (+19), floor 17 — new battery `the Contract-review-hold: line …` (19) |
| `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` | 49 cases in 8 batteries | 62 cases in 9 batteries (+13) — new battery `the hold: …` (13) |

Pinned:

- The recogniser's shape (decoration, lowercasing, the 7-hex floor, every refusal), the template verbatim in `contract-review.md` beside 「24 小时」, newest-governs, per-head clearing, and prefix matching.
- The 24-hour age as a reading: 23 h 59 min reads live and not overdue; 24 h reads live and overdue.
- No gate reads it: a record beside a hold still reads FOUND, and the claim and hand-off readings are unchanged.
- In the reader: the same row is TAKE (b) without a hold and WAIT with one. A stale or unreadable hold holds nothing. (a) and (c) still fire under a hold. HELD and DONE are unchanged. Listing works at 24 h, an unknown age is listed rather than dropped, and nothing is listed on DONE or HELD rows. `--json` carries the hold through the live reader, and the status vocabulary is pinned at exactly four.

## Acceptance notes

- **Tier:** the card says 「Tier H (`.claude/**`)」. By AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 and the register `GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (row `claude-tree`, `GOVERNED_TIER_S`), `.claude/**` is **Tier S**, and `scripts/pm/**` is off the register. The seat lands this after its own contract review.
- **Folded clauses (lines paid by deletion, each restated where named):**
  - `triage-duties.md` old L3 「分诊席每次 fire 开局读本文;本文是分诊座位的全部职责。」 and its blank separator L4. Reader and scope are SKILL.md 〈阶段细则索引〉 L86 (「分诊席每次 fire 开局」 · 「分诊座位职责」). The dropped 「全部」 was not true: triage duties also live in `contract-review.md`, `state-machine.md` L40 (answering `pm:retriage`, the duty item 2 is about) and `landing-operations.md` 约定③. Four other references (`filing-gate.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`, `cross-repo-coordination.md`, `execution-duties.md`) already open without a header sentence.
  - `triage-duties.md` L60 「涉 cloud 整卡归 cloud 车道」, bytes only, paying item 2's clause. Restated by SKILL.md L165 (`domain:cloud`: 「涉 cloud 即整卡归 cloud PM」) and `cross-repo-coordination.md` L44 (same words), which triage reads before routing per SKILL.md L85. 「路由是分诊的技术判断」 → 「路由属分诊技术判断」 keeps the meaning.
  - `contract-review.md` old L30–31 → L33, dropping 「(申报面外三面加 ④)」. Restated by the same file's L39 (「④ 设计判断欠 schema、governed 规则文本、收窄三面」) and L41 (「余面同形无 ④」).
  - `contract-review.md` old L43, the isolated reviewer's scratch rule. `record-recognisers.mjs --brief-template` prints it in the brief's ⛔ READ-ONLY block, and that script's self-test pins it ("…and scopes scratch to the PR-named directory, reading nothing not written this round"). L44 makes that template the brief's starting point and forbids deleting its ⛔ lines.
  - `contract-review.md` old L48–49 → L49, dropping 「判据机读已提交树」. Restated by the same file's L17 (「面读 PR 已提交树的文件清单」) and `triage-duties.md` L11 (「纯重生成/只动散文面例外(判已提交树)」). The reader that decides it is `record-recognisers.mjs`, battery "a pure-regeneration head move KEEPS the record, decided on the COMMITTED trees".
- **Item 2's home:** the sentence 「父单是协调节点」 does not exist on `origin/main` `c5d46341` (zero hits under `.claude/` and `scripts/pm/`). The nearest are `triage-duties.md` L60 「父单永不派发」 and `filing-gate.md` L16 「④ 协调节点」, so item 2 rides L60. L75's exception list governs the stale-premise re-check of in-flight cards (L73–75), not `pm:retriage` answers, which `state-machine.md` L40 governs.
- **Item 3's 24-hour clause** lives in `contract-review.md` with the rest of the hold rule, not in `triage-duties.md`. Reason: the recogniser's self-test may read only the two governed files `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` already declares for it (`project-forms.md`, `contract-review.md`), and it pins the template and 「24 小时」 there.
- **WAIT, not a fifth `HOLD` status (measured):** `git grep check-owed-reviews` finds no in-repo consumer of `--json`. In the file, a new status would touch `STATUS_ORDER`, the header counts, the row regex and the trigger condition, and `HOLD` sits one letter from `HELD`. A held head is the lane's own wait, so it stays WAIT, with the hold printed and listed.
- **The hold's age is a reading, never a lapse:** whether a free-text condition is met is no reader's to judge. An overdue hold still holds (b) and is listed, so it cannot become a silent skip.

The declaration census pins `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs:77 self-test-reads`, and my new header roster line had moved that declaration to `:78`. `167b0027` folds the roster entry into the existing hand-off/claim roster line, and the gate is green at 1935 cases.
